title: Cousin and Girlfriend
overview: A reporter asks about love at the shopping mall where Rentaro and some of the girls are.

overview: Rentaro introduces his new girlfriend to the family as always, but she's shocked by the state of affairs.

overview: The new Japanese teacher seems obsessed... with the United States?
